definitions.ask: Should dependency recovery also ignore dangling links that name no task in the vault, the way reconcile does?
definitions.why: reconcile keeps unresolved links on purpose, so they will come back

choices.label: One stale Depends-On or Pomodoro link elsewhere can no longer leave a ⌃L task Blocked
Any dangling link outside `_conflicts/` still defers every release to reconcile

definitions.ask: Should ⌃⇧B (and the Blocks stage's ↵) also settle the note of the task its lane transfer promotes?
definitions.why: same helper and one more call site in the same chord family

choices.label: The promoted prerequisite's note is grouped and badged in the same gesture, like ⌃B
Only ⌃L and ⌃B change; ⌃⇧B keeps leaving the promoted task's note for reconcile
